stage_1_scope_note: Per AC-Q3-A-a/b/c, only TMIN/TMAX/RMIN/RMAX used for Stage 1; ALTMX/pH/photoperiod/GMIN/GMAX/latitude excluded per probe-1-A scope clarity. CLIZ field also excluded per AC-Q3-A-d (data-completeness gaps).

fields.TMIN: Absolute minimum annual temperature tolerated by the crop (°C)
fields.TMAX: Absolute maximum annual temperature tolerated by the crop (°C)
fields.thermal_screen: How Stage 1 reads a single thermal kill (P10 extreme tmin below TMIN, or P90 extreme tmax above TMAX): annual (the default when absent) = incompatible; seasonal = marginal, because the crop is planted in the season that avoids it
fields.thermal_screen_source: The source of a seasonal screen, quoted verbatim with its retrieval date; required when thermal_screen is seasonal

potato.thermal_screen_source: RECA Niger, Guide pratique de la culture de la pomme de terre en Afrique de l’Ouest, §3.2: 'En dessous de 700 m d’altitude, il est dès lors impératif de planter la pomme de terre durant la saison fraîche sèche', retrieved 2026-09-27; FAO ECOCROP 1971 optimum 15-25 °C, retrieved 2026-09-24
